title: Data warehouse Test Analyst
text: Data warehouse Test Analyst at FinXL IT Professional Services (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Looking to hire an experienced Test Analyst with strong Data warehouse experience, Sydney- Long Term Opportunity Experience required: • Data Warehouse Automation Tester for at least 5 years • Has at least 4 years’ experience building automation using BDD framework (Preferably Cucumber) • Ability to simplify & prepare test cases, plan, conditions & documents independently • Has experience with agile workflow delivery using JIRA, Confluence Mandatory skills : SQLs (Preferable Netezza), Cucumber , Having X-Ray is a plus Optional Skills : Tableau, Unix, ETL tool (Preferable DataStage), Git (Jenkins) Tasks: • Ready to start building data warehouse automation scripts. • Define & prepare test scenarios, conditions, plan & document • Regular showcase of each portion of automation completed
